values.note: Reservation only through Maryland DNR's reservation site, up to 365 days ahead and for the same day; DNR: 'No walk-ins permitted.' Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

values.note: Four large drive-in sites (001-004) take RVs and trailers to 40 ft; the four small ones (005-008) are tent sites. All full sun.

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Savage River recreation page and the booking site: reservation only (no walk-ins), 365-day window with same-day booking, $10-11. Added: 8 sites (4 RV/trailer to 40 ft, 4 tent), no hookups, year-round. Not stated: facilities beyond 'Restrooms are available on site' at the ORV trail (type not given).
flags: Criteria (OHV staging camp): the campsites belong to the St. John's Rock ORV Trail. DNR lists them under that trail ('13-mile off-road vehicle trail system ... including a 200-foot rock crawl ... Eight campsites (4 large, 4 small) are available by reservation only ... Pricing varies by number of ORVs. A Maryland DNR Off-Road Vehicle permit is required ($10 annually).'), and the booking site's directions end 'approximately 1 mile to the ORV trail entrance' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/SavageRiver/recreation-trails.aspx). AWH 2026-10-02: OHV staging camps of any owner are out of scope. The trail road is also open to 'hunters, sightseers, and fuelwood cutters'.
Fees (not edited, human-checked): DNR says 'Pricing varies by number of ORVs', so the $10-11 recorded may be the price without ORVs.
Phone: entry has none; Savage River State Forest headquarters is 301-895-5759 (booking site Contact Information; DNR page).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/SavageRiver/recreation-trails.aspx.
